name: Taqueria Potosina
tagline: Breakfast tacos right off the highway on Spur 515 in Navasota.
about: Taqueria Potosina is a casual Mexican restaurant at 513 Spur 515 in Navasota.
Regulars stop in for breakfast tacos, and it's an easy stop on the drive between College Station and Houston.

reviews.name: A Yelp reviewer
reviews.text: The red sauce has some great flavor and the green sauce has a nice bite to it.

conflicts: No posted hours were found, so the page leaves hours off. Restaurantji shows a lower 3.0 rating from 44 ratings; the page uses the Yelp figure shown on MapQuest.
